alerts.headline:
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9, and again from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday and Tuesday, Oct. 12-13, two lanes of eastbound I-90 will close between Lakemont Boulevard Southeast and East Sunset Way/Highlands Drive NE for pavement repair. 

At least one lane will remain open each night. Delays are possible through the work zone.

The northbound I-405 off-ramps to westbound and eastbound SR 520 will be closed overnight from 11:59 p.m. – 5:30 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from I-90 (milepost 11.5) to Northeast Eighth Street (milepost 13.6)
will be closed overnight from 9:30 p.m. – 7:30 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of
Saturday, Oct. 10.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 11:30 p.m. – 6 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

The Northeast 10th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

The Bellevue Way Southeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

Maintenance crews will intermittently close a mile of the tolled lanes on northbound I-405 between Bellevue and Lynwood between 9 p.m. and 5 a.m. nightly for toll equipment maintenance work. The work will start near Southeast 8th Street in Bellevue on the evening of Monday, Oct. 12 and then proceed north each night until reaching the end of the tolled lanes near I-5 in Lynnwood on the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. Only a mile of the lanes will be closed at a time.

Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast (milepost 10) to Northeast
44th Street (milepost 8) will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct.
9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10.

Up to four lanes of southbound I-405 from Northeast Eighth Street (milepost 14) to I-90 (milepost 11.5)
will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday,
Oct. 10.
The northbound and southbound SR 527 on-ramps to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
The Northeast 195th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 195th Street will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12.
All lanes of southbound I-405 between SR 527 (milepost 26.35) and SR 522 (milepost 23.47) will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 4 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12
From 8 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12 to noon Friday, Oct. 16, the northbound Interstate 5 SeaTac rest area will close for maintenance.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed overnight from 8 p.m., Friday, Oct. 9 – 8 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed overnight, from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 – 7 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10.
Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed overnight from 8:30 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 9 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed overnight, 11 p.m.
Friday, Oct. 9 – 7 am. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 10 p.m.
Friday, Oct. 9 – 6 am. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The 70th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight, 11 p.m. Friday,
Oct. 9 – 8 am. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to 70th street will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Friday,
Oct. 9 – 6 am. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed overnight, 10 p.m.
Friday, Oct. 9 – 6 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10.

The right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 will close during the day Sunday through Thursday for about six weeks for ongoing fish passage construction. 

From 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., one lane of southbound SR 161 will close.

From 9 p.m. to 5 p.m., one lane of northbound SR 161 will close.

People traveling through the area during these times should expect delays, particularly during peak travel times.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7.5) to Coal Creek Parkway
Southeast (milepost 10.2) will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct.
9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7:30 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

The North Southport Drive on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 9 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 10. A signed detour will be in place.

People traveling to or through Seattle the weekend of Friday, Oct. 9, through Monday, Oct. 12, should plan for overnight closures of the Interstate 5 express lanes. The express will be closed at the following times: 
11 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9, to 8 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10
11 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 10, to 8 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 11
11 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 11, to 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.

Monday, Oct. 5, on most weeknights until Friday, Oct. 23 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The ramp will reopen at 6 a.m. each of the following mornings. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on westbound SR 520 past the Montlake and Lake Washington boulevard exits will detour to southbound I-5.
Sound Transit crews will close the northbound I-5 off-ramp to Northeast 130th Street in Seattle from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9, until 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 19.

Monday, Oct. 5, on select nights until the morning of Sunday, Oct. 11 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. on the nights of Oct. 5, 6, 8, and 10. All traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 during these hours will cross Lake Washington and pay the SR 520 Bridge Toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need to access Montlake from I-5 must take alternate routes.

Sound Transit crews will close the right lane of northbound I-5 between North 185th and North 200th streets from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 12, until Wednesday morning, Oct. 14. The northbound I-5 off-ramp to eastbound SR 104 also will close at the same time

Daily from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 2:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Sky Lane (milepost 49) for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Tuesday, Oct. 20 and Wednesday, Oct. 21.
From 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 5, through Friday afternoon, Oct. 9, the left lane of eastbound I-90 will close near the SR 18 interchange in Snoqualmie. Expect delays in the area.

Daily from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 1 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, one left lane of northbound State Route 599 from Interstate 5 to South 133rd Street (milepost 0) will close for maintenance.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9 to 9 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 10

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the Ebey Slough Bridge to 88th Street Northeast (milepost 200) will close for maintenance work.
From 8 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 11 to 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12, State Route 96 traffic at 51st Avenue Southeast (milepost 3) will alternate with flaggers for utilities work.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings beginning Monday, July 27, one lane of State Route 203 will be closed for a paving project between just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20). Flaggers and pilot cars will direct alternating traffic through the remaining open lane.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
